removed.en: Here is why a whole append-only sequence is still linear. After growing a sufficiently large list of size `m`, proportional spare room allows at least a fixed fraction of `m` further single-item appends before another growth. Charge the cost proportional to `m` of that growth across those following appends; each receives only a constant charge. Equivalently, look backward from final capacity `C`: successive earlier growth sizes shrink by a fixed factor below one, apart from small sizes. Their copying work is bounded by `C + rC + r²C + ... = C/(1-r)` for some fixed `r < 1`. To see the bound, multiplying the sum by `r` leaves the original sum minus its first term; subtraction gives `(1-r)S = C`. Small initial capacities add fixed work. Final capacity is proportional to the final length, so `d` single-item appends, including their ordinary writes, take `O(d)` total work. This aggregate guarantee is called amortized constant time per append. It applies here because each adjacency list only grows by one appended item at a time; no alternating deletion or bulk update is being smuggled into the argument.
removed.zh-TW: 為什麼整段 append-only sequence 仍是 linear？一個夠大的 list 在大小為 `m` 時成長後，會有與 `m` 成正比的 spare room，因此至少還能做某個固定比例乘上 `m` 次的單項 appends，才需要再次成長。把這次與 `m` 成正比的成長成本分攤給接下來那些 appends，每次只需分到 constant charge。也可以從最終 capacity `C` 往回看：除去小尺寸的情況，歷次成長的大小會按某個小於一的固定比例縮小。其複製工作有 upper bound：`C + rC + r²C + ... = C/(1-r)`，其中 `r < 1` 是某個固定值。要理解這個界，把整個和乘上 `r`，就得到原本的和扣掉第一項；兩式相減便是 `(1-r)S = C`。初期的小 capacities 只增加固定工作。最終 capacity 與最終 length 成正比，因此 `d` 次單項 appends，連同一般的寫入，總共花費 `O(d)` 工作。這個 aggregate guarantee 稱為每次 append 的 amortized constant time。這裡可以使用它，因為每個 adjacency list 都只靠每次 append 一項來成長；論證並未暗中混入交替刪除或 bulk update。
